fullContentHtml:
HPSC HCS and Allied Services Final Result 2026 – Full Details

Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the final result for the recruitment of Civil Services Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 102 posts. Applications for the HPSC Haryana Civil Service HCS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from February 06, 2026, to February 26, 2026. The mains examination was held on 27, 28 & 29 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their HPSC Civil Service HCS Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 30 January 2026
  • Application Start Date : 06 February 2026
  • Last Date : 26 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 26 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 28 April 2026
  • Prelims Exam Result : 04 June 2026
  • Revised Prelims Result : 01 June 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 27, 28 & 29 June 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 22 June 2026
  • Interview Date : August / September 2026
  • Mains Result : 17 September 2026
  • Final Result : 17 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, BC, ESM : Rs. 250/-
  • Female All Category : Rs. 250/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is HPSC HCS and Allied Services Final Result 2026?

HPSC HCS and Allied Services Final Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
